protocol.resampling_unit: same 11 rawtime sessions; shared session draws for all conditions and contrasts
protocol.primary: frame-weighted mean, sum session error totals / sum sampled session frame counts

limitations: One trained G1S1 LAST6000 checkpoint; repeated tune11 sessions, not untouched holdout.
Nominal changes time input to both motion and scene time embeddings, not just motion.
Image mismatch/repeated/reversed histories break physical image/pose correspondence; diagnostics, not compliance proof.
Session percentile CIs are exploratory, unadjusted for four contrasts.
